name: linkpeek
description: Chrome extension: hold X and click any link for an AI summary in a bubble, without leaving the page.

scripts.icons: for s in 16 32 48 128; do rsvg-convert -w $s -h $s icons/icon.svg -o icons/icon-$s.png; done
scripts.zip: rm -f linkpeek-*.zip && zip -r -X "linkpeek-$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version").zip" manifest.json icons src LICENSE -x '*.DS_Store' -x 'icons/icon.svg'
